scope: Single-factor ablations validating which design choices in the SCIT-Speech pipeline are necessary

control_variant.description: Hand-designed SeaNet encoder (n_filters=64, lstm=2, ELU, base_seanet_resnet_block)
control_variant.data_source: exp1 stage1_profile - hand_encoder row (proxy training, NOT full Exp2-style training)
control_variant.caveat: Quality numbers are from short-distill proxy training; not directly comparable to full 60-epoch SCIT-Speech-Base training

treatment_variant.description: NAS-searched encoder (nas_seed42_000896): n_filters=24, lstm=1, Snake, layer_ops=[skip,std_k7,sep_k9,dil_k5]
treatment_variant.data_source: exp1 stage1_profile - nas_seed42_000896 row + exp2 distill30 SCIT-Speech-Base full training

ablations.key_metric: encoder_params, encoder_macs, encoder_rtf, plus L=1/2/3 wave_l1/mel_l1/stoi from exp4
ablations.expected_finding: NAS encoder reduces params -86.9%, MACs -89.5%, RTF -55.1% versus hand-designed; full-training quality comparison requires hand-designed full retrain (future work)
ablations.decoder_control_caveat: Both variants use identical SeaNet decoder + frozen RVQ interface; comparison is encoder-only as required by exp5 plan section 4

control_variant.training_summary: 60-epoch from-scratch training, distill_lambda=30, no random-L, no ChannelSim

treatment_variant.description: SCIT-Speech-LCA v2: LCA fine-tuning with strong ChannelSim + consistency loss
treatment_variant.training_summary: 10-epoch LCA fine-tuning from Base, strong-perturb (p_drop<=0.10, p_sub<=0.03), lambda_consistency=0.5

ablations.key_metric: WER, mel_l1, stoi at L=1/2/3 clean conditions; perturbation degradation at L=3
ablations.expected_finding: LCA v2 marginally improves clean reconstruction (mel_l1 ~3-4% lower, stoi +0.01); LCA's main benefit is robustness under perturbation (exp3 v2 robustness analysis: 6/6 metrics positive robust_imp)

control_variant.description: SCIT-Speech-Base trained with distill_loss_lambda=0 (no semantic distillation from HuBERT teacher)
control_variant.training_summary: 60-epoch from-scratch training, identical to Exp2 distill30 except distill_loss_lambda=0

treatment_variant.description: SCIT-Speech-Base trained with distill_loss_lambda=30 (the production variant from Exp2)
treatment_variant.training_summary: 60-epoch from-scratch training with distill_loss_lambda=30, NAS encoder

ablations.key_metric: WER, semantic_similarity (proxy via WER vs ground-truth), mel_l1 at L=1/2
ablations.expected_finding: Without distillation, low-layer indices (L=1) lose semantic content - measurable as WER degradation at L=1 vs the distill30 baseline

control_variant.description: Trained without random L sampling - full-depth (n_q=3) only at every step
control_variant.data_source: exp2 SCIT-Speech-Base IS effectively this control (no random-L during exp2 training)

treatment_variant.description: Trained with random L sampling - per-batch L drawn uniformly from {1,2,3}
treatment_variant.data_source: exp3 SCIT-Speech-LCA v2 USES random-L during 10-epoch fine-tuning

ablations.key_metric: L=1/2 wave_l1/stoi - random-L should help low-layer reconstruction
ablations.data_source: exp4 184-row evaluation - same Base-vs-LCA contrast carries the random-L signal
ablations.caveat_confound: A4 control vs treatment is NOT a clean isolated single-factor ablation: LCA v2 also adds ChannelSim + lambda_consistency + lambda_comm=1.5 changes vs Base. Strictly attributing the LCA improvement to random-L alone is overstatement. A clean A4 would require training a Base-style 60-epoch run with random-L ON but no ChannelSim and no consistency loss, ~24h GPU. Listed as future work.
ablations.expected_finding: LCA v2 (random-L on) outperforms Base (random-L off) on low-layer mel_l1 by 3-5%, but other LCA-specific factors confound this attribution. The exp3 v2 dev-matrix data (where random-L is held constant across LCA evaluation steps) provides stronger evidence that random-L is the unifying factor for L=1/2/3 simultaneous performance.

control_variant.description: No ChannelSim during training (LCA-style training but without index perturbation)
control_variant.data_source: Approximated by exp3 LCA v1 (weak ChannelSim p_drop<=0.03, p_sub<=0.005, lambda_consistency=0)
control_variant.caveat: v1 has weak (not zero) ChannelSim. A pure ChannelSim-off variant requires another 10h training run; v1's weak ChannelSim is a reasonable proxy because exp3 v1 robustness analysis showed near-zero robustness improvement (effectively no benefit)

ablations.key_metric: Robustness improvement (clean - perturbed degradation) - already computed in exp3 v2 summary
ablations.expected_finding: v1 (weak ChannelSim) showed near-zero robustness improvement on 6/6 metrics; v2 (strong + consistency) showed positive robustness on 6/6 metrics with mel_l1 12/12 cells improved

exp1.purpose: NAS encoder search; provides hand-designed and NAS encoder profiling data

exp2.purpose: SCIT-Speech-Base production training; serves as A2 control + A3 treatment + A4 control

exp3_v1.purpose: LCA v1 (weak channel sim) - serves as A5 control proxy

exp3_v2.purpose: LCA v2 (strong channel sim + consistency) - serves as A2 treatment + A4 treatment + A5 treatment

exp4.purpose: Provides 184-row audio quality + WER/CER table for non-training ablations (A2, A4, A5)

execution_strategy: C: distillation=0 only - train one new variant (A3_distill0), reuse all others from existing experiments. Total estimated GPU: ~24-28 hours.
